title: Estimating Geotechnical Parameters via Electrical Resistivity Tomography
summary: Researchers combined electrical resistivity tomography with core drilling and lab testing to estimate subsoil geotechnical parameters in Morocco.

title: Receptive English Proficiency Across Engineering Programs
summary: A study of Vietnamese engineering students revealed a consistent proficiency hierarchy across different academic program types and cohorts.

title: Uncertainty Modeling of Mechanical Properties in Warm Frozen Clay
summary: Researchers used copula theory to investigate the dependence between strength and elastic modulus in warm frozen soil for roadbed stability.

title: Automated Gravel Transport Measurement Using Impact Plates
summary: Stainless-steel impact plates equipped with accelerometers were installed in a watershed to automate the measurement of gravel transport.

title: Bearing Capacity Prediction for Foundations in Rock Slopes
summary: A novel finite-element limit analysis software was developed to assess end bearing capacity for foundations in Hoek-Brown rock slopes.

title: Comparative Impacts of Algal Biomass on Potato Purée
summary: Researchers characterized the fortification effects of various algal biomass types on the rheological and physical properties of potato purée.

title: Structural Optimization of a Downward Air Duct Dust Collector
summary: Computational fluid dynamics simulations were used to optimize partition plates and tube sheet structures for improved dust collector flow uniformity.

title: Trust-Aware Framework for Sparse Mobile Crowdsensing
summary: A reinforcement learning-based framework was proposed to optimize data collection and inference accuracy while filtering out untrustworthy workers.

title: Device Bias Instability in Scaled Oxide Semiconductor 2T0C DRAM
summary: Researchers studied bias instability in BEOL-compatible oxide semiconductor transistors to improve 2T0C DRAM retention and circuit reliability.

title: Applied Game for Spatial Audio in Mobile XR
summary: An applied game using hardware LiDAR sensors and real-time sound spatialisation was developed to simplify spatial audio deployment in mobile XR.

title: Smart IoT Objects Infer Human Spatial Reasoning
summary: A new proof-of-concept system uses smart IoT objects to monitor physical interactions and quantitatively infer human spatial reasoning.

title: Supervised ML Improves SDN Traffic Classification
summary: Combining supervised machine learning models with software-defined networking architecture achieves high-accuracy traffic classification for quality of service management.

title: Earth Pressure Analysis for Pit-Retaining Structures
summary: An integrated theoretical and numerical study investigates earth pressure against pit-retaining structures rotating around lateral supports with log-spiral failure surfaces.

title: Repairable Steel Beam-Column Connection with Perforated Plates
summary: A novel steel connection featuring peanut-shaped perforated flange cover plates improves seismic performance and energy dissipation.

title: Study Uncovers Hidden Costs of OpenBIM Interoperability
summary: A mixed-methods study in China's construction industry reveals widespread interoperability issues and hidden costs associated with OpenBIM adoption.

title: Secure Zero-Touch Edge Cloud Framework for 6G E-Health
summary: A reference architecture integrates 6G networking, medical IoT, and edge intelligence to support latency-sensitive e-health services.

title: Attention-Enhanced Point Cloud Segmentation for Tunnels
summary: A novel deep learning network uses parallel dual-level attention for high-precision semantic segmentation of 3D point clouds in tunnel construction.

title: Survey on Tensor-Based Spatiotemporal Data Imputation
summary: This study systematically reviews modeling strategies and knowledge engineering perspectives for tensor-based spatiotemporal data imputation.

title: Self-Luminescent COF Boosts Coreactant-Free ECL Sensors
summary: A novel cyano-vinylene-linked covalent organic framework enables coreactant-free electrochemiluminescence for sensitive iodide and iodixanol detection.

title: Enhanced Magnetoelectric Coupling in Gd-Doped BiFeO3 Ceramics
summary: Phase-boundary engineering in Gd-doped BiFeO3 ceramics achieves enhanced magnetoelectric coupling and robust high-temperature performance up to 480 K.

title: Large Eddy Simulation of Submerged Water Jets
summary: Large eddy simulation analyzes submerged water jet flow fields and momentum transfer to evaluate coal-breaking efficiency under varying jet pressures.

title: Fire-Induced Flexural Capacity of Composite Girders
summary: A new analytical and finite-element model evaluates the severe deterioration of flexural capacity in prestressed composite girders with corrugated steel webs at high temperatures.

title: Acoustic Emission Monitoring of Heated CFRP Beams
summary: Acoustic emission monitoring successfully detects early damage evolution and interface changes in CFRP-strengthened reinforced concrete beams exposed to moderate elevated temperatures.

title: Microneedle Patches at the Bio-Agricultural Interface
summary: Microneedle patches evolve from biomedical devices into sustainable agricultural tools for precision plant diagnostics, nutrient delivery, and food safety screening.

title: SEM-CLIP 2.0 for Nanoscale Defect Detection
summary: SEM-CLIP 2.0 introduces a zero- and few-shot learning framework using learnable text prompts for accurate nanoscale defect classification and segmentation in semiconductor manufacturing.

title: Secure Edge-Cloud Architecture for 6G Health Monitoring
summary: An interoperable edge-cloud framework improves temporal synchronization and latency for motion-capture health monitoring in adolescent sports over 6G networks.

title: Energy-Efficient Clustering for Wireless Sensor Networks
summary: A K-nearest neighbors clustering strategy combined with hierarchical protocols reduces energy dissipation and extends network lifetime in heterogeneous wireless sensor networks.

title: Production Conditions Affect CdS Pigment Properties
summary: This study investigated how raw materials, synthesis routes, and thermal treatment influence the crystallographic structure and optical properties of cadmium yellow pigments.

title: Analysis of Construction Dispute Factors Using KGE and DEMATEL
summary: Researchers identified 15 key construction dispute factors and mapped their cause-effect relationships using Gaussian knowledge graph embedding and DEMATEL methods.

title: Settlement Analysis for Gravity Wharfs on Variable Foundations
summary: A new framework evaluates long-term settlement in spatially variable marine clay foundations under consolidation-creep coupling conditions using an equivalent modulus.
